column1: # Ordered step list for the phase progress line (D84), read by scripts/step-progress.sh. Display data only: guards,
# status-transition.sh and the decision flow keep using the node ids; this file never changes what a step does.
# Rows are in run order within each phase (0.3.22 before 0.3.8; 3.16 and 3.15 before 3.13 and 3.9), not id order.
#   track  both | full | light   a counted step on both paths, the full path only, or the light path only
#          phase                 a phase header: id P<n>, title is the phase name
#          cross                 00.x cross-cutting node (persistent artifacts, model and profile lookup, discovered work);
#                                not counted, shown after the linear step it was entered from (--at)
#          intake                0.0.x sizing before a spec exists; no progress line
#          side                  an artifact written alongside other steps, never a step of its own; not counted
# Lines starting with # are comments. Keep in step with PLAN/decision-flow-reference.md (tests/lint/step-list.sh).
